notes: v1.14.556 — THE MULTI-TAB WARNING NOW REACHES THE PHONE. PHANTOM warns that a second tab risks DATA LOSS, but on the device that matters it could not appear. ⛔ TWO THINGS HAD TO BE TRUE AT ONCE, which is why this hid so long: #phantom-tab-pill is hidden by @media (max-width:480px) with display:none !important — a deliberate v1.14.391 call, since the chrome wordmark overlapped it by ~93px at 390 and something had to stand down — and tab_pillRefresh set an INLINE display:inline-flex, which can never beat an !important. So on every iPhone the function faithfully updated a chip nobody could see. Meanwhile showBanner() renders only into #boot .boot-items and returns early once boot is dismissed, by its own comment, so it fires BEFORE a second tab is opened and nothing fires after. An operator who opened a second tab mid-shift was told nothing at all, while the pill own tap text says close it to avoid data loss. ⭐ CORRECTION TO MY OWN STAGE 3.4 FINDING: I recorded that the redesign had no in-app multi-tab warning. That was imprecise — it is hidden only at <=480px, so a laptop shows it and a phone does not. The gap was real; the reason was narrower than stated. THE FIX: the warning moves off the pill and onto a toast, which has no viewport constraint. It latches on the 0-to-N transition and clears when the peers go, so a genuinely new second tab warns again but a tab left open all shift does not nag every 20 seconds. The pill still works above 480 where there is room for it. Four tests in 46-multi-tab-warning pin all of it, and were mutation-tested: with the toast suppressed, three fail and the pill test correctly still passes.
